tool_input.description: Authorize and destroy AWS resources (EC2 and S3 bucket)

tool_input.command:
cat > cleanup-preview.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "Shutting down preview environment completely..."

# Delete Kubernetes resources
echo "Deleting Kubernetes deployment and namespace..."
kubectl delete deployment preview -n preview-feature-ledger --ignore-not-found=true
kubectl delete namespace preview-feature-ledger --ignore-not-found=true

# Destroy AWS infrastructure
echo "Destroying AWS resources..."
cd infra
terraform destroy -auto-approve

echo "Preview environment shutdown complete."
EOF
chmod +x cleanup-preview.sh
cat cleanup-preview.sh
tool_input.description: Create cleanup script for preview environment

- `cleanup-preview-env.sh` — Manual cleanup script (for any resources already deployed to the cloud)

The preview environment infrastructure definitions have been deleted and committed. No new instances will be created, and nothing remains in the configuration that could accidentally redeploy it. If there are any existing resources still running in Kubernetes or AWS, use the cleanup script to destroy them.
